requirements.quote: An endpoint MUST ignore transport parameters that it does not support.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a transport parameter that it does not support.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint must ignore the unsupported transport parameter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not apply or act on the unsupported transport parameter.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be given an unsupported transport parameter and observed to verify that processing continues without applying that parameter.

requirements.quote: The absence of a transport parameter therefore disables any optional protocol feature that is negotiated using the parameter.
requirements.condition: When a transport parameter used to negotiate an optional protocol feature is absent.
requirements.required_behavior: The optional protocol feature negotiated by that parameter must be disabled.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The implementation must not enable the optional protocol feature in the parameter's absence.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can omit the relevant transport parameter and verify that the associated optional feature remains disabled.
